file_stem: RWB TE 011 PDPA lint for code tests and logs
title: PDPA lint for code, tests and logs
goal: Fail the build when personal data appears in code, logs, exceptions or fixtures
why: PDPA leaks usually start in a log line or a test fixture. The rules are generated from the data dictionary, and the lint never prints the value it found.
triggers: PdpaLintStep on every PR and main build
ace_note: No runtime ACE read. Personal fields come from sys_fields and the API spec; note the story still names pre-alignment party / contact_point fields.
stores: pdpa-rules.yaml (generated); pdpa-allow.yaml (owner, reason, expiry); CI pipeline

path.text: Build fails: rule, file, line (no value)

rules: BR1: the personal field list comes from the dictionary
BR6: an allow entry needs an owner, a reason and an unexpired date
BR7: never print the value found
risks: A log writes a personal field -> PDPA-LOG-FIELD
A fixture holds a valid Thai ID -> PDPA-FIXTURE-ID
example: -> build fails with PDPA-LOG-FIELD naming first_name
The value itself is not printed
